faq.title: Frequently asked questions about logistics control towers

q1.q: What is a logistics control tower?
q1.a: A platform that centralizes trips, incidents, costs, risks and SLA in real time, enabling integrated monitoring and decision-making for logistics operations.

q2.q: Which companies is Nexum Tower for?
q2.a: Carriers, logistics operators, shippers, distribution centers and teams that need operational visibility and performance control.

q3.q: Does Nexum Tower replace a TMS?
q3.a: Not necessarily. It complements or integrates with TMS, ERP and trackers as a control, monitoring and operational intelligence layer.

q4.q: Can the platform track trips in real time?
q4.a: Yes. The tower consolidates trip status, alerts and indicators for continuous operation monitoring.

q5.q: Can you control costs and margin per trip?
q5.a: Yes. The costs module compares planned vs actual and supports margin management by trip, client or route.

q6.q: Does the system have AI for operational analysis?
q6.a: Yes. Nexum AI interprets operational data and helps answer questions about trips, delays, costs and incidents.

q7.q: Does Nexum Tower have a client portal?
q7.a: Yes. The client portal offers delivery and SLA visibility without manual status requests.
